limitations: No mixture weights, approval states, source files, audit resolutions, or training jobs changed.
Training-context percentages are dated owner reports and cannot establish current-source quality.
The three-record sample is useful for a bounded allocation hypothesis, not a library-wide ranking.

proposal.baseline: equal 20/20/20 authoring minutes across the three seeded records
proposal.bounded_test: For each family, attempt at most four 3-demo/4-query episodes and at most eight generation attempts. Require current source/rule hashes, seven distinct lawful inputs, Racket labels, and demonstration-only rejection of relevant answer-changing rivals. Stop a family immediately on label disagreement/source drift; stop volume expansion if fewer than 3/4 episodes pass or if duplicate/rejection cost exceeds 2 attempts per accepted episode.
proposal.estimate_label: authoring-time hypothesis, not measured training quality or global optimum
proposal.rationale: Spend only a bounded confirmation on 9c69's already reproduced three-blob/axis defect; prioritize the approved bb75 API-boundary repair; retain substantial time for 9ada's explicit marker-4 lesson ambiguity and ignored-axis repairs.
proposal.success_metric: accepted identifiable query targets per Racket-labeled grid and per authoring minute, with coverage of advertised axes/roles reported separately

selection.algorithm: Primary ticket target plus the first two other main-pool IDs ordered by SHA256(ticket_seed + ':' + task_id).
